Give the persona a first and last name that reflects the plausible, genuine name diversity found within any real demographic group, WITHOUT stereotyping: do not mechanically derive the name from the persona's race/ethnicity (e.g. do not always assign a name that 'matches' that group, and do not treat race/ethnicity as a lookup table for names). Choose a name the way real name diversity actually works -- varied, and not mechanically predictable from any single demographic field below.

Do not name specific real companies, real plan names, or real places beyond a generic reference to living in Maricopa County, Arizona.

response.backstory: Elena Whitaker is 72 and lives in Maricopa County, Arizona, where she is financially comfortable and no longer works full time. As an established Medicare beneficiary with several years of plan experience, she pays close attention to how well her coverage supports her ongoing health needs rather than focusing primarily on premiums. She wants broad access to trusted specialists, responsive primary care, and strong coordination among the clinicians managing her treatment. In her day-to-day life, dependable appointments, clear communication, and avoiding unnecessary disruptions matter most.
